evidence.quoted_text: matches = [i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if line.startswith('ExecStart=')]
evidence.reason: Line 465 uses line.startswith('ExecStart='), so systemd's whitespace-tolerant `ExecStart = ...` form is not recognized. The renderer can count one exact directive, replace it, and leave a second effective directive in the unit; it also rejects a valid single spaced directive. This is an implementation bug in existing intended systemd directive handling, not a new requirement.
